All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for unbound", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for unbound fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-77860: 'serve-expired' can bypass Unbound 'wait-limit' (bsc#1280403).
- CVE-2026-77955: Possible ZONEMD verification bypass window (bsc#1280404).
- CVE-2026-78227: Use-after-free in DoQ stream output buffer on reset re-transmission (bsc#1280405).
- CVE-2026-80225: Possible degradation of service from continuous queries on the same TCP/DoT connection (bsc#1280406).
- CVE-2026-81634: Possible heap buffer overflow during DNSSEC canonicalization (bsc#1280409).
- CVE-2026-81642: Heap buffer overflow and possible Remote Code Execution when digesting DNSKEY (bsc#1280411).
- CVE-2026-82717: CNAME synthesis could lead to heap corruption (bsc#1280412).
- CVE-2026-82720: Use-after-free in DoH stream cleanup code path (bsc#1280413).
- CVE-2026-85501: Retrap: Novel Vulnerabilities to launch Algorithmic Complexity Attacks on DNSSEC (bsc#1280414).

Changes for libunbound-devel-mini:

- Updated to version 1.26.1

Changes for unbound:

- Updated to version 1.26.1
